Title: Azure Lab Services has removed the unlimited option from quota per user to help save on costs

Body.Content:
Azure Lab Services has removed the unlimited option from quota per user so lab owners can intentionally choose a specific number of hours needed for each lab to help save costs.  

The new default is now 10 hours of quota. This change won’t affect existing labs, which already have an unlimited quota. It only takes effect if you’re changing quota on existing labs or creating a new lab.  

To provide feedback or make suggestions, go to the feedback forum. 

Have a question? Go to Stack Overflow. 

Learn more
